messages:
Tamara (People Ops): Thanks for joining today — recording + slides: https://redwood.example.com/allhands-mar2026

Tamara (People Ops): Follow-up thread for Q&A items. Drop anything we missed and we'll answer here. Promised to clarify: promo timeline, packet template, leveling vs peer comp, midyear comp exceptions, 401k timing.

Tamara (People Ops): Promo timeline (short): `Manager nominations: Mar 15-31
Calibration panel: Apr 10-14
Leadership sign-off: Apr 20
Effective date: May 1` — packet template is pinned in #docs.

Eli: If I'm in a promo slate and an internal transfer opens, can I pursue both?

Tamara (People Ops): Yes. Being in a slate doesn't block internal hiring. We'll coordinate timelines so you don't lose either opportunity. If there's conflict, msg me and we'll triage.

Nadia: For calibration, should manager writeups focus only on ladder criteria or include market/peer context? I'm prepping examples.

Chris: I couldn't find the new packet referenced in the all-hands. Is there a rubric we should attach?

Tamara (People Ops): Use the updated packet in #docs (pinned). It has a short rubric and example phrasing. Calibration looks at ladder expectations + demonstrated scope/impact; managers should include 2-3 concrete examples and any relevant customer/metric impact. Peer/market data are used as context but not the primary gating factor.

Sam: Are there midyear comp adjustments or are raises only in Q4?

Tamara (People Ops): We maintain a small midyear exception/retention pool. Managers can nominate Apr 1-15 for urgent cases (high flight risk, counteroffers). Broad merit cycles remain in Q4.

Nadia: Will calibration notes be shared with ICs?

Tamara (People Ops): Managers will share decision outcomes and key feedback. Full calibration notes are for leaders/HR; summaries should be provided in 1:1s.

Tamara (People Ops): Benefits / 401k: policy unchanged. Match timing questions -> benefits@redwood.example.com. We will post a short explainer doc this week.

PeopleOpsBot: Office hours created: Thu Apr 4 11:00 PT. Invites sent to folks who reacted :hand: in the all-hands thread.

Eli: Thanks, will bring a timing scenario to office hours.

Chris: Got it, updating my packet now. Where do managers upload final packets?

Tamara (People Ops): Upload to the Promotions folder in HR drive (link pinned in #docs) and add a short comment in the packet checklist thread.

Sam: If someone gets a retention adjustment midyear, does that affect next cycle's calculation?

Tamara (People Ops): It can. Small exceptions are treated as off-cycle adjustments and are noted in next cycle's comp calibration so we avoid double-counting.

Nadia: Appreciate the clarity.

Tamara (People Ops): Thanks everyone. If anything else pops up, reply here or book office hours. I'll post the recording + packet link to #docs shortly. :thumbsup:
